questions.text: docs/techstack.md still lists the frontend framework as 'Not Yet Specified'. Which framework should web-ui use for the onboarding form, hospital profile and Super Admin alert screens (e.g. React, Angular, Vue, Next.js)?

The Requirement also needs backend work: saving the form, locking the counts, logging Super Admin corrections, calculating yearly averages, and the 2x/3x alert checks. The only application is web-ui. Should this Work Item cover both the UI and the backend, or only the web-ui screens (with the backend as a separate Work Item/application)? If it includes the backend, which runtime/language should the microservices use (not yet specified in techstack.md)?

The form is filled in at first sign-up, but the auth mechanism is 'Not Yet Specified' in techstack.md. How does the tenant create their login: email + password, phone OTP, Google sign-in, or something else? And is creating the login part of this Work Item?

The data store is a per-tenant web-based SQLite database. Where should the onboarding form data and baseline counts be stored: in a platform-level (Super Admin) database, or in the new tenant's own database created at sign-up? Super Admin alerts need to read across all tenants.

How often should the 2x/3x alert check run: each time a delivery/USG/NICU/LSCS event is recorded, or as a scheduled job (e.g. daily)? And how should the Super Admin receive alerts: an in-app alert list only, or also email/SMS?
